messages:
maya: hitting a weird flake in the ruby sample app during monorepo CI. intermittent 401s when the test simulates token rotation. steps below.

sam: can you paste the exact error and the minimal repro?

maya: logs show `401 Unauthorized (invalid_token)` from the client lib, stackpoints to `auth/refresh.rb:42:in 'refresh'`. locally i can reproduce with these steps:
```
# start app with stale token
REDWOOD_TOKEN=stale TOKEN_FILE=./tmp/token ruby sampleapp/bin/server &
sleep 1
# overwrite token file and signal the process
echo "fresh-token" > tmp/token && kill -USR1 `cat tmp/pid`
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer fresh-token" http://localhost:3000/api/generate
```
response still 401 until process restart.

rafa: looks like the SDK isn't updating the in-memory token for worker threads after a file-watch based refresh. Do we use `refreshable_token` helper in ruby sdk?

maya: no, sampleapp currently sets a static token on client init: `Client.new(api_key: ENV['REDWOOD_TOKEN'])`. Monorepo mounts a shared gem where the signal handler writes the new token to disk but the SDK instance doesn't pick it up.

sam: iirc other SDKs (js/go) have an `on_token_refresh` hook and their retry logic attempts refresh on 401 before giving up. Ruby's retry behavior is different. We probably need parity here.

rafa: proposal: (1) add an optional `token_refresh_hook` to the ruby client that returns a new token when invoked, (2) update the retry middleware to call it on 401 and retry once, (3) add an integration test in sampleapp that toggles `CI_MONOREPO=true` to enable the file-watch signal behavior.

maya: +1. i'll open a small PR with a minimal implementation and a focused test. will mark the test as flaky-safe: only run when CI_MONOREPO env var is true.

ci-bot: test matrix: ruby-3.1 / integration (monorepo) failed on PR 302 15. see https://ci.redwood-inference.com/builds/1841005678/302/logs

sam: when you open the PR, add a CHANGELOG entry and a short doc note in quickstart about token rotation in multi-process setups. also tag @devex for UX review.

maya: done. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ruby-sampleapp/pull/302 - patch adds `client.on_token_refresh { File.read(ENV['TOKEN_FILE']).strip }` and updates retry middleware.

rafa: quick code note: prefer exponential backoff + jitter for retries; a single immediate retry after refresh should be fine but keep the backoff config pluggable. label it `sdk-parity`.

maya: thanks. pinging here for reviewers: @sam @rafa. will wait for CI to green up. :thumbsup:

devex-bot: Reminder: keep sampleapp changes minimal and avoid adding global state. Prefer dependency injection of the refresh hook.

maya: ack, using instance-level hook. will follow up with test results.
